recommendations.description: Implement an OH SNF - FREE STANDING policy remediation for LTSS Dual Eligible and TANF Standard that targets concentrated provider subsets with contract and site-of-care review, audits utilization management KPI changes, validates PA-required and non-PA authorization-to-claim enforcement, and confirms claims are processing to contractual reimbursement methodology.
evidence: OH LTSS Dual Eligible / SNF - FREE STANDING added $50.3M.
Admissions and paid per admit rose for LTSS Dual Eligible in N and Y.
OH TANF Standard / SNF - FREE STANDING added another $9.1M.
TANF Standard growth was mostly admission-led.
Source cards flag auth_dimension_present and repeated_delta_concentration.

recommendations.description: Audit OH Medicaid TANF Standard PA-required claims in the Not Mapped facility bucket for auth-to-claim matching and claims-processing accuracy, correct facility and site-of-care attribution, then rerun the bucket by true facility and provider before UM or contract action.
evidence: OH TANF Standard / Not Mapped / Y increased $10.1M.
Admissions rose by 408.
Paid per admit increased about $21.6K.
Flags include auth_dimension_present and unmapped_or_unknown_value.

recommendations.description: Institute a temporary hold on reimbursement and UM decisions tied to AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION, and complete targeted auth-to-claim reconciliation plus claim reclassification/reprocessing across CA, IN, and TN for Riley's Children's Health, Fresno Heart & Surgical Hospital, Methodist University Hospital, and the affected California DRGs before any authorization denial enforcement or downstream policy use.
evidence: AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION changes are a gating data issue across CA, IN, and TN.
Flags include auth_or_mapping_shift and requires_validation_before_action.
Riley's Children's Health, Fresno Heart & Surgical Hospital, and Methodist University Hospital are concentrated sites.
CA impact touches Cirrhosis, Kidney/Urinary, and Poisoning DRGs.
Reconcile logic and reclassify affected claims and admissions before downstream business action.
peer_benchmarking: Centene: no prior authorization required; sepsis claims may receive pre/post-pay DRG validation review.
United Health: no prior authorization, notification, or state-specific authorization requirements stated.

recommendations.description: Conduct a RILEY'S CHILDREN'S HEALTH targeted policy review for IN Medicaid CHILDRENS PA-required non-ER IP Med/Surg admissions in TANF Standard and ABD Non Dual to confirm prior authorization was obtained and matched to actual claims, enforce authorization denials, validate contractual claims processing, and pursue contract, site-of-care, and step-down discharge remediation where indicated.
evidence: RILEY'S CHILDREN'S HEALTH concentrates the IN CHILDRENS admission increase.
Both source cards are PA-required with auth code Y.
TANF Standard at Riley is volume-led.
ABD Non Dual at Riley shows higher paid per admit.
Both cards flag auth-to-claim validation.
peer_benchmarking: United Health bundles routine services, supplies, equipment, nursing, and ventilator/CPAP management.

recommendations.description: Audit Fresno Heart & Surgical Hospital CA Medicaid ACUTE HOSPITAL admissions with auth=Y under TANF Standard and ABD Non Dual for PA-to-claim match, denial enforcement, and contract-compliant payment, focusing on Cirrhosis and Alcoholic Hepatitis with CC, Other Kidney and Urinary Tract Diagnoses with CC, and Poisoning and Toxic Effects of Drugs without MCC; route persistent outlier volume or payment to site-of-care and contract remediation review.
evidence: Fresno Heart & Surgical Hospital represented $1.2M of CA TANF Standard growth.
PA-required CA TANF Standard acute utilization growth added $1.7M.
Cirrhosis/hepatitis and kidney/urinary diagnoses drove mixed volume and unit-cost pressure.
ABD Non Dual showed 13 admissions with about $24.2K higher paid per admit.
peer_benchmarking: Molina summary shows no inpatient rule scope and no prior authorization requirement.

recommendations.description: Reconcile prior authorizations, denials, and paid claim actuals for Medicaid TANF Standard PA-required acute hospital admissions in MO and VA at diagnosis level, prioritizing Depressive Neuroses, Neuroses Except Depressive, Cirrhosis and Alcoholic Hepatitis with CC, and Poisoning and Toxic Effects of Drugs without MCC, and in MO validate claims adjudication against contractual reimbursement obligations.
evidence: MO mixed pressure is led by Depressive Neuroses and cirrhosis/hepatitis.
VA contributes additional volume-led acute hospital cirrhosis/hepatitis growth.
MO and VA source cards carry auth_dimension_present flags.
MO has higher paid per admit in key diagnoses.
